entries.zh: 撒开、摊开撒播；倒出、泼洒（谷物、液体等）
entries.en: to scatter, to spread out; to spill, to pour out
(of water) to spill over, to overflow, to run over
entries.notes: H「到擋」字面难通（疑「倒擋／倒擔」之讹），据西语 derramarse agua（水漫出）及 M 音 tō fâ 定作水漫溢。

entries.zh: 泼洒在地；把液体泼到地上（泛指，不限定所泼之物）
entries.en: to spill or splash (something) on the ground; to throw down and scatter, generically
to brim over, to overflow (as water rising and spilling)
entries.notes: 西语「Veno」疑为「lleno」（满）之讹或 veneno 误写；H「洋溢」明示水满而溢，故取满溢义。

entries.zh: 摊派、分派（赋税、徭役名额）；按名册逐名征派、登记入册
entries.en: apportionment of a levy; distribution of quotas; to enroll and apportion by name on the register
to melt; to found, to cast (metal)

entries.zh: 熔解金属；冶炼熔化金属
entries.en: to melt down metals; to smelt metal

entries.zh: 熔解、消融（金属化为液态）
entries.en: to melt down, to dissolve (metal) into a molten state
entries.notes: L「melates」与 H「渾／潿」均带疑，M、R 音 hūn huâ 近「渾化」，取金属熔融消解义。

entries.zh: 熔化（金属）；熔化的金属、金属熔液
entries.en: to melt (metal); molten metal, metal in its melted state
entries.notes: L「derrenido」为 derretido 之讹；H 首字疑「鍂／鉎」，M 音 Lé 与 R 音 Séng 不合，据「…水」定作金属熔液。

entries.en: to throw down, to overturn, to knock down
(of the wind) to blow something down

entries.zh: 把（金属器皿上的）凹痕顶凸、敲平使复原；凸起、鼓出
entries.en: to beat or push a dent out (of a metal vessel), to restore a dented thing; to bulge out
entries.notes: H 仅「凸」一字且 M（chín）与 R（têin）音值不合，据 desabollar（去凹痕）推为自内顶凸、敲平。

entries.zh: 味淡、淡而无味；（引申）言语无趣、不中听
entries.en: tasteless, insipid, bland; (fig.) flat, dull, unwelcome in speech
entries.notes: R 栏 fān 与「淡」常读不合，疑异读或笔误；H「淡」与 desabrido 义密合。

entries.zh: 性情乖戾、脾气坏；令人不快、讨人嫌
entries.en: ill-tempered, of bad disposition; unpleasant, disagreeable
entries.notes: H「問拗」疑为「悶懊／悶拗」之讹（M 音 bûn âu 可读「悶懊」），据西语 mala condicionados 取性情乖戾义。

entries.en: written challenge; letter of defiance, challenge to combat by letter

entries.zh: 松散凌乱、不整齐（尤指船舱货物堆叠失序）
entries.en: untidy, loose and disordered (esp. of a ship's cargo stowage); disarranged
entries.notes: 「ò g.」疑为 o generalmente 之缩写；H「鬅鬆」示松散不整，指船舱货堆凌乱。
